title: Gather your papers
subject: Money

text: The return is only as good as the forms you have in hand.
Start in January. Employers and banks have until late January to send most forms.
Every job that withheld tax sends a W-2. Box 1 is wages. Box 2 is federal tax withheld.
If you had three jobs, you need three W-2s. A missing one is a common reason a return gets held.
1099-NEC or 1099-K can mean gig or contract work. 1099-INT is bank interest. 1099-G is unemployment.
Unemployment is taxable. A side gig is taxable even if no form arrived. Keep your own record.
You need a Social Security number for yourself, a spouse, and each dependent.
For a child tax credit or EITC, the child's SSN generally must be issued by the due date of the return.
You drove for a delivery app and also had a W-2 job. What do you need?

choices.label: The W-2 and a record of the gig income, plus any 1099 that arrived.
Only the W-2. Gig income is not taxed.
Nothing. The IRS already has it.

text: W-2 for wages. 1099 for other income. Your own record if a form never comes.
SSNs for everyone on the return. Do not file with a blank.
